description: Na₃CaSc₃Zn(SiO₃)₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.62 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with eight SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one ZnO₆ pentagonal pyramid, and edges with two equivalent ScO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.59 Å. Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted CaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with eight SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one ScO₆ pentagonal pyramid, and edges with two equivalent ZnO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.52 Å. There are three inequivalent Sc sites. In the first Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted ScO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one CaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent ZnO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are four shorter (2.05 Å) and two longer (2.30 Å) Sc-O bond lengths. In the second Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted ScO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.25 Å. In the third Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted ScO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.25 Å. Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted ZnO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, edges with two equivalent CaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.37 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid,  a cornercorner with one ZnO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with two equivalent CaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ScO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.70 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid,  a cornercorner with one ScO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ScO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.68 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid,  a cornercorner with one ScO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ScO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.68 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid,  a cornercorner with one ScO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with two equivalent CaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ZnO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.69 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Zn, and one Si atom.
